summary: Iterative gate (plateau-based multi-round KB retrieval) shipped. daemon.js /search now accepts exclude_keys (comma-separated, dropped from RAG candidates pre-ranking in both gated and ungated paths) and round (default 1), and returns continue: true iff round<3 AND a new rag-tier note scored >=0.5; gated DAG block untouched. lib/mcp-core.js search_knowledge schema gained exclude_keys/round, passed through to /search; continue flows back in the result. scripts/bench-heldout.js: added 'iterative' consult mode + PREAMBLE.iterative. Daemon restarted on 8787 and verified: round 1 (top score 0.641) → continue:true; round 2 with round-1 keys excluded → zero overlap, continue:false; round 3 → continue:false.
